about: the Royal Rumble breakage (2026-10-27: the arcade's memory zeroed, announcers in the ring, wrestlers clipping, slowdown) the way the user hit it: Bret Hart (the player, slot 0) does his back suplex from a real back grapple over and over -- the CPU fights for him, and every few seconds the mod (qa_bsuplex) puts him behind a man standing in the ring, grabs him and does entry 73 (Falling Back Drop, his Revenge animation). The exe's guard (WCW_GUARD_MOD) makes the arcade's packs read-only: a write there is a crash report naming the writer

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: Bret Hart is in it
expect.check: s0_id == 0x060D or s1_id == 0x060D or s2_id == 0x060D or s3_id == 0x060D

expect.name: the script got him into back grapples
the back suplex was done from them
no model's matrices ever went bad
